changelog.summary: Adds an exact-policy access exception to reviewed remediation and same-cell independent retest.

title: Access Exception to Verified Fix
description: Connect an authorized permission mismatch to an owned fix, deployed build, independent same-cell retest, and closure decision.
setup_prompt: Use Access Exception to Verified Fix as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Access Review Analyst and Security Remediation Coordinator Crews, written test scope, approved permission policy, isolated actors and fixtures, exact build, issue and deployment sources, independent retest owner, and closure authority. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, blocking artifact validators, and one manual denied-cell case. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not probe a system, grant access, create a ticket, merge, deploy, close an exception, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Written target scope and approved role, tenant, resource and action policy
Exact build, environment, isolated actor, tenant, resource and fixture
Authorized UI, direct API, audit and policy evidence or bounded exports
Issue, approval, repository, deployment and retest records
Security, asset, change, independent retest and closure owners
Manual-only or reviewed policy/change event and repeat route
